items.title: Qwen1.5-110B: The First 100B+ Model of the Qwen1.5 Series
items.summary: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DEMO DISCORD Introduction Recently we have witnessed a burst of large-scale models with over 100 billion parameters in the opensource community. These models have demonstrated remarkable performance in both benchmark evaluation and chatbot arena. Today, we release the first 100B+ model of the Qwen1.5 series, Qwen1.5-110B, which achieves comparable performance with Meta-Llama3-70B in the
items.summaryZh: 通义千问团队正式发布了Qwen1.5系列的第一个千亿参数级开源模型Qwen1.5-110B。在基础模型评估中，该模型取得了与Meta-Llama3-70B相媲美的性能；在MT-Bench和AlpacaEval 2等对话评估中，也展现出了卓越的表现，丰富了开源社区的大模型生态。
